question: Does retrospective correction or its guard improve accuracy on varied binary tasks and switching intervals?
hypothesis: Guarded correction provides a meaningful improvement over otherwise identical no-correction and unguarded variants.
primary_metrics: first 100 online predictions after each switch

bootstrap.interval: descriptive 95% seed-paired percentile; unadjusted across conditions

limitations: Public synthetic tasks and previously inspected candidate; fresh seeds only, not a blind holdout. Phase lengths change training exposure. No matched compute or peak-memory measurement.
